name: task-history
description: A collapsible task history of the current session in a side pane: each prompt, its result, open questions, files and duration.

summaries.title: AI summaries
summaries.description: Summarize each finished task with a small model (title, one-line result, open questions, follow-up grouping). Off: raw text only, no model calls.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: The model alias or id used for summaries.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Raise a desktop notification when a task that ran for 20 seconds or more ends: all (done, waiting, failed), waiting (only when Claude asks you something), off.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the running or waiting task in the status line, so it is visible with the pane closed.

gitFiles.title: Files from git
gitFiles.description: Compare git status before and after each turn, so files changed by shell commands are listed too.
